# Project Phoenix v30.0 WP26-B — Compliant Era Soundtrack Playlists & Bilingual Historical Encyclopedia. Generated by gen_v300_wp26_encyclopedia_and_music.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# ==============================================================================
# Unified Compliant Wwise Playback Wrapper (ONLY verified vanilla-safe MusicPlayer_* IDs)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (root = human player country).
oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { oe_aud_rule_is_off = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_cue_cd value = 1 months = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_cd value = 1 months = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_last_rule value = $rule_id$ }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_play_count } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_play_count value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_play_count add = 1 }
		post_audio_event = {
			persistent_object = music_manager
			event = $track$
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Toggle WP26 era-weighted soundtrack mute state independently.
oe_wp26_mus_toggle_mute = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
		remove_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_muted value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Evaluates the active era & cultural sphere and fires one weighted playlist cue.
oe_wp26_mus_select_weighted_cue = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_wp26_mus_can_play = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r01_532_roman = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_01 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r02_532_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_02 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r03_532_persia_levant = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_03 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r04_532_india = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_04 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r05_532_west = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_05 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r06_1204_roman_exile = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_06 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r07_1204_latin_west = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_07 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r08_1204_east_asia = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_08 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r09_1453_roman = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_09 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r10_1453_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_10 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r11_1453_near_east = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_11 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r12_1453_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_12 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r13_1648_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_13 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r14_1648_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_14 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r15_1648_indo_persia = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_15 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r16_1776_atlantic_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_16 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r17_1776_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_17 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r18_1776_global_frontiers = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_18 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_is_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_10 = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_is_roman_sphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_01 = yes
		}
		else = {
			oe_wp26_mus_play_rule_12 = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Fires the signature opening anthem for non-1337 historical eras once on Day 1.
oe_wp26_mus_play_era_opening = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_opening_done }
			NOT = { oe_aud_rule_is_off = yes }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp26_mus_muted }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp26_mus_opening_done value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r01_532_roman = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_05_The_Rise_of_an_Empire
				rule_id = 1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r02_532_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Yingzhou_Gudiao_the_Moon
				rule_id = 2
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r03_532_persia_levant = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_syrian_Syrian_hymn_from_Syrian_orthodox_church
				rule_id = 3
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r04_532_india = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_deccan_raga_saraswathi
				rule_id = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r05_532_west = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_01_Overture_I_Genesis
				rule_id = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r06_1204_roman_exile = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_07_For_the_Lost_Ones
				rule_id = 6
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r07_1204_latin_west = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_19_O_quam_gloriosum
				rule_id = 7
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r08_1204_east_asia = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Yingzhou_Gudiao_the_Fish
				rule_id = 8
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r09_1453_roman = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_07_For_the_Lost_Ones
				rule_id = 9
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r10_1453_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Yingzhou_Gudiao_the_Moon
				rule_id = 10
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r11_1453_near_east = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_syrian_Semai_Nahawand
				rule_id = 11
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r12_1453_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_03_Royal_Court_Invitation
				rule_id = 12
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r13_1648_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_26_Peace_of_Westphalia
				rule_id = 13
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r14_1648_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Ambush_from_Ten_Sides_The_Complete_Epos
				rule_id = 14
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r15_1648_indo_persia = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_deccan_raga_saraswathi
				rule_id = 15
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r16_1776_atlantic_europe = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_16_The_Path_to_Potsdam
				rule_id = 16
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r17_1776_sinosphere = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Yingzhou_Gudiao_the_Moon
				rule_id = 17
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_wp26_mus_r18_1776_global_frontiers = yes }
			oe_wp26_mus_play_verified_track = {
				track = MusicPlayer_sol_iroquois_Haundenosaunee
				rule_id = 18
			}
		}
	}
}
